items.name: Buffer
items.summary: A contiguous memory region that can be shared with other buffers and across  thread boundaries that stores Arrow data.

methods.name: advance
methods.summary: Increases the offset of this buffer by `offset`

methods.name: as_ptr
methods.summary: Returns a pointer to the start of this buffer.

methods.name: as_slice
methods.summary: Returns the byte slice stored in this buffer

methods.name: bit_chunks
methods.signature: fn bit_chunks(&self, offset: usize, len: usize) -> BitChunks<'_>
methods.summary: Returns a `BitChunks` instance which can be used to iterate over this buffers bits in larger chunks and starting at arbitrary bit offsets. Note that both `offset` and `length` are measured in bits.

methods.name: bit_slice
methods.signature: fn bit_slice(&self, offset: usize, len: usize) -> Self
methods.summary: Returns a slice of this buffer starting at a certain bit offset. If the offset is byte-aligned the returned buffer is a shallow clone, otherwise a new buffer is allocated and filled with a copy of the bits in the range.

methods.name: capacity
methods.summary: Returns the capacity of this buffer. For externally owned buffers, this returns zero

methods.name: claim
methods.summary: Register this [`Buffer`] with the provided [`MemoryPool`]

methods.name: count_set_bits_offset
methods.signature: fn count_set_bits_offset(&self, offset: usize, len: usize) -> usize
methods.summary: Returns the number of 1-bits in this buffer, starting from `offset` with `length` bits inspected. Note that both `offset` and `length` are measured in bits.

methods.name: data_ptr
methods.summary: Returns the pointer to the start of the buffer without the offset.

methods.name: from_custom_allocation
methods.signature: unsafe fn from_custom_allocation(ptr: NonNull<u8>, len: usize, owner: Arc<dyn Allocation>) -> Self
methods.summary: Creates a buffer from an existing memory region.

methods.name: from_iter
methods.signature: fn from_iter<I: IntoIterator<Item = T>>(iter: I) -> Self

methods.name: from_slice_ref
methods.signature: fn from_slice_ref<U: ArrowNativeType, T: AsRef<[U]>>(items: T) -> Self
methods.summary: Initializes a [Buffer] from a slice of items.

methods.name: from_trusted_len_iter
methods.signature: unsafe fn from_trusted_len_iter<T: ArrowNativeType, I: Iterator<Item = T>>(iterator: I) -> Self
methods.summary: Creates a [`Buffer`] from an [`Iterator`] with a trusted (upper) length.

methods.name: from_vec
methods.summary: Create a [`Buffer`] from the provided [`Vec`] without copying

methods.name: into_mutable
methods.summary: Returns `MutableBuffer` for mutating the buffer if this buffer is not shared or sliced. Returns `Err` if this is shared or the [`Self::ptr_offset`] is greater than 0 or its allocation is from an external source or it is not allocated with…

methods.name: into_vec
methods.summary: Converts self into a `Vec`, if possible.

methods.name: is_empty
methods.summary: Returns true if the buffer is empty.

methods.name: len
methods.summary: Returns the number of bytes in the buffer

methods.name: ptr_eq
methods.summary: Returns true if this [`Buffer`] is equal to `other`, using pointer comparisons to determine buffer equality. This is cheaper than `PartialEq::eq` but may return false when the arrays are logically equal

methods.name: ptr_offset
methods.summary: Returns the offset, in bytes, of `Self::ptr` to `Self::data`

methods.name: shrink_to_fit
methods.summary: Tries to shrink the capacity of the buffer as much as possible, freeing unused memory.

methods.name: slice
methods.summary: Returns a new [Buffer] that is a slice of this buffer starting at `offset`.

methods.name: slice_with_length
methods.signature: fn slice_with_length(&self, offset: usize, length: usize) -> Self
methods.summary: Returns a new [Buffer] that is a slice of this buffer starting at `offset`, with `length` bytes.

methods.name: strong_count
methods.summary: Returns the number of strong references to the buffer.

methods.name: try_from_trusted_len_iter
methods.signature: unsafe fn try_from_trusted_len_iter<E, T: ArrowNativeType, I: Iterator<Item = Result<T, E>>>(iterator: I) -> Result<Self, E>
methods.summary: Creates a [`Buffer`] from an [`Iterator`] with a trusted (upper) length or errors if any of the items of the iterator is an error. Prefer this to `collect` whenever possible, as it is ~60% faster. # Safety This method assumes that the iter…

methods.name: typed_data
methods.summary: View buffer as a slice of a specific type.
